title: Claims Processing, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Claims Processing agent on real SharePoint lists that hold the workshop's synthetic records, with its own managed app. Easy mode has brainfreeze studio build all of it; Manual mode builds the same thing by hand.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 4 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Claims Processing Claims list.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including Burst pipe in upstairs bathroom caused water damage to ceiling, walls, and flooring in two rooms (ClaimId CLM-2025-7001), with Claimant Margaret Sullivan.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Claims Processing Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 4 skills, 1 rules knowledge file(s) and 4 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Claims Operations Leader
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which incoming claim needs specialized handling first, and where should it be reviewed?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: CLM-2025-7003; Investigation. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Claims Adjuster
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: What is missing from Jennifer Liu’s theft file before I can evaluate it?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: CLM-2025-7004; Receipts or appraisals. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: SIU Investigator
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which claim crosses the SIU review threshold, and does that prove fraud?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: CLM-2025-7003; SIU Referrals. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Claims Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Show the policy-term estimates and state clearly whether any claim was approved or paid.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: CLM-2025-7002; No approval. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Claims Processing: 4 read-only tabs from the same lists. 4 fictional records, including Burst pipe in upstairs bathroom caused water damage to ceiling, walls, and flooring in two rooms (ClaimId CLM-2025-7001), with Claimant Margaret Sullivan.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Claims Processing Claims from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload claims.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set ClaimId, Claimant, PolicyNumber, PolicyType, DateOfLoss, DateFiled, LossType, Adjuster, Status, SupportingDocs to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep ClaimedAmount, FraudScore as Number. Name the list Claims Processing Claims. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including Burst pipe in upstairs bathroom caused water damage to ceiling, walls, and flooring in two rooms (ClaimId CLM-2025-7001), with Claimant Margaret Sullivan.

steps.title: Create Claims Processing Policy Details from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload policy-details.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set PolicyDetailId, Effective, Expiry to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep CoverageLimit, Deductible, PremiumAnnual as Number. Name the list Claims Processing Policy Details. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including HO-445892 (PolicyDetailId HO-445892), with CoverageLimit 350000.

steps.title: Create Claims Processing Fraud Indicators from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload fraud-indicators.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set FraudIndicatorId to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep Weight as Number. Name the list Claims Processing Fraud Indicators. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 8 fictional records, including Claimant shows signs of recent financial distress (FraudIndicatorId financial_stress), with Weight 15.

steps.title: Create Claims Processing Adjuster Notes from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload adjuster-notes.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set AdjusterNoteId, Value to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Name the list Claims Processing Adjuster Notes. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including CLM-2025-7001 (AdjusterNoteId CLM-2025-7001).

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Claims Process Studio Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there. Then, in the last section (SharePoint site), replace YOUR_SITE_ADDRESS with your site's address, for example https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/AIBASTSyntheticDataManual. The list tools need it: Copilot Studio still asks the model for the site and list on every call.
steps.expected: The instructions start with Claims Processing Agent — Studio Global Instructions, name the four list tools, and end with your site's address.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload aibast_claims-processing-controls-and-review.md, and wait until ready. Do not upload the synthetic-records file: those records come from the list tools.
steps.expected: 1 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the claims tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Claims Processing Claims; name the tool Get claim records.
steps.expected: Get claim records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the policy details tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Claims Processing Policy Details; name the tool Get policy detail records.
steps.expected: Get policy detail records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the fraud indicators tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Claims Processing Fraud Indicators; name the tool Get fraud indicator records.
steps.expected: Get fraud indicator records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the adjuster notes tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Claims Processing Adjuster Notes; name the tool Get adjuster note records.
steps.expected: Get adjuster note records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 4 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 4 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 4 skills, the rules knowledge and 4 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 4 skills, 1 knowledge file(s), 4 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else.

steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which incoming claim needs specialized handling first, and where should it be reviewed?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: CLM-2025-7003; Investigation. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.prompt: What is missing from Jennifer Liu’s theft file before I can evaluate it?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: CLM-2025-7004; Receipts or appraisals. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which claim crosses the SIU review threshold, and does that prove fraud?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: CLM-2025-7003; SIU Referrals. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Show the policy-term estimates and state clearly whether any claim was approved or paid.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: CLM-2025-7002; No approval. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: claims-processing-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 4 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Claims Processing Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Claims Processing Claims" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Claims Processing Policy Details" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Claims Processing Fraud Indicators" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Claims Processing Adjuster Notes" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 4 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Claims Processing Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Claims Processing Claims tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 4 fictional records, including Burst pipe in upstairs bathroom caused water damage to ceiling, walls, and flooring in two rooms (ClaimId CLM-2025-7001), with Claimant Margaret Sullivan.
